id.description: The user id of the agent.

email.description: A made-up address. It receives no email.

ownerUserId.description: The owner of a personal agent. Null for a workspace agent.

items.description: `read` reads the board. `write` files, updates, comments and closes. `delete` removes records.
items.title: AgentScope

active.description: True if the agent can act. A personal agent is active while it has a live token. A workspace agent is active until somebody revokes it.

lastUsedAt.description: The last time that a token of the agent authenticated. Null if no token did. A workspace agent has no token, so it always has null.

401.description: The request has no valid token or session.

403.description: You asked for all agents, and you are not a workspace admin.
